findings.title: A material answer to a limited report

findings.title: The disclaimer echoes failed trust

findings.mechanism: The focus copula, unseen, and guardian carriers meet the immediately prior pledge and admitted neglect. The contact lets the ordinary epistemic excuse carry a second self-indicting resonance without removing its ordinary function.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the brothers' defense as morally double-edged: it limits knowledge while recalling a trust they failed to keep.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory secondary resonance, not a replacement translation and not proof that the speakers consciously confess the earlier failure here.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record explicitly marks this outlier exploratory and legacy-unbound, with exact 12:80 and 12:81 surface anchors.

findings.title: Knowledge as a followable evidence path

findings.reader_payoff: The reader gains a concrete picture of how a limited report can travel through signs and witnesses without becoming omniscient.
findings.containment: This is a qualified evidentiary metaphor, not a hidden translation of the focus clause and not a claim that every branch is a literal path.

findings.containment: This is a narrative inversion, not a doctrine that vision is irrelevant or that the father's knowledge supplies the hidden answer.

findings.title: The report remains inside kinship

findings.containment: This does not add a new genealogy, convert fatherhood into a theological source, or replace the ordinary family references.

findings.title: Local knowledge against a world-total field
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 occurrence of worlds gives the focus knowledge claim a bounded-world contrast: the brothers' known portion is local rather than universal.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the scale of the focus limitation without turning it into a claim that the speakers should know everything.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory external overlay, not a direct meaning of the focus word and not a whole-surah theological thesis; the other added Fātiḥa ayat do not independently change this local contact.

epistemic.reason: The external ayah and focus surface are exact, but the cross-ayah branch activation is an uncandidate macro overlay and is therefore exploratory.

friction_notes: The 12 legacy-unbound HFT records provide exact Arabic surface anchors, but their context segmentation, roots, branch identities, and roles remain attributed; unresolved branches are therefore retained only with attributed application and no invented gloss.

The explicitly added Fātiḥa members were quarantined during the native/pericope review. Only 1:2 survived the overlay review through a specific shared-root carrier and focus return; 1:3-1:7 supplied no additional local activation beyond the retained pericope readings.
No supplied candidate carried a semantic_obligations array; all supplied HFT trace roles and changed-reading obligations were nevertheless represented directly in branch activations.
